question: A modem is connected to a:
solution:
The correct answer is **phone line**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Modem** stands for Modulator-Demodulator.
 
• A modem converts digital data from a computer into analog signals that can be sent over a **phone line**.
 
• It also converts incoming analog signals back into digital data.20
 
• This is essential for internet connectivity over traditional phone lines.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
 

 Option
 Details
 
 

 Option 1
 A modem is connected to a **phone line** for internet connectivity.
 
 

 Option 2
 A mouse is a peripheral device used to interact with a computer's user interface.
 
 

 Option 3
 A motherboard is the main circuit board of a computer, connecting all components.
 
 

 Option 4
 A monitor is an output device that displays information from the computer.
